title: Differential Privacy for Streaming Data
summary: A research codebase implementing streaming differential-privacy mechanisms (Naive Binary, Binary Restarts, Interval Restarts) that release private answers to counting and MWEM/MST-based synthetic-data queries over datasets like Adult Income and ACS census data. Its data preprocessing module imports RDT's HyperTransformer and OrderedLabelEncoder to encode dataset columns before they are fed into these DP query engines.
